tours.name: Create a Salary Rule
tours.description: Learn how to add a new salary rule, such as a fixed allowance, to a salary structure: name it, give it a category and a code, attach it to a structure, set the amount and save it.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to add a new salary rule, such as a fixed allowance, to a salary structure: name it, give it a category and a code, attach it to a structure, set the amount and save it.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Salary rules are configured in the Payroll app. Each rule produces one line on the payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: Salary rules are configured in the Payroll app. Each rule produces one line on the payslip.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: Configuration holds the settings that decide how every payslip is calculated.

description_i18n.en_US: Configuration holds the settings that decide how every payslip is calculated.

steps.title: Rules
steps.description: This list shows every salary rule of every structure, grouped by category. Check it first to avoid creating a rule that already exists.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every salary rule of every structure, grouped by category. Check it first to avoid creating a rule that already exists.

steps.title: New rule
steps.content: Click New to create a salary rule.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a salary rule.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank rule. A rule needs a name, a category, a code and the structure it belongs to.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank rule. A rule needs a name, a category, a code and the structure it belongs to.

steps.title: Rule name
steps.content: Type the name of the rule, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name of the rule, then press Tab.

steps.description: The name is the label that appears on the payslip, for example Transport Allowance. Choose something employees will understand.

description_i18n.en_US: The name is the label that appears on the payslip, for example Transport Allowance. Choose something employees will understand.

steps.title: Category
steps.content: Click here to open the list of categories.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the list of categories.

steps.description: The category groups the rule with similar ones, for example Basic, Allowance or Deduction. It also decides whether the amount adds to or reduces the net pay.

description_i18n.en_US: The category groups the rule with similar ones, for example Basic, Allowance or Deduction. It also decides whether the amount adds to or reduces the net pay.

steps.title: Choose the category
steps.content: Click the category of this rule. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the category of this rule. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

steps.description: Pick Allowance for an amount added to the salary, or a deduction category for an amount taken off.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick Allowance for an amount added to the salary, or a deduction category for an amount taken off.

steps.title: Code
steps.content: Type a short code for the rule, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a short code for the rule, then press Tab.

steps.description: The code identifies the rule in formulas and reports. Keep it short, in capital letters and without spaces, for example TRANSPORT.

description_i18n.en_US: The code identifies the rule in formulas and reports. Keep it short, in capital letters and without spaces, for example TRANSPORT.

steps.title: Structure
steps.content: Click here to open the list of salary structures.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the list of salary structures.

steps.description: A rule only runs on payslips that use its structure. Choose the structure of the employees who should receive this rule.

description_i18n.en_US: A rule only runs on payslips that use its structure. Choose the structure of the employees who should receive this rule.

steps.title: Choose the structure
steps.content: Click the structure for this rule. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the structure for this rule. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

steps.description: The rule is added to the chosen structure and appears on its Salary Rules tab.

description_i18n.en_US: The rule is added to the chosen structure and appears on its Salary Rules tab.

steps.title: Fixed amount
steps.content: Type the fixed amount, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the fixed amount, then press Tab.

steps.description: With the default computation, the rule adds this fixed amount to every payslip that uses it. Other computation types, such as a percentage or a Python formula, are available for more complex rules.

description_i18n.en_US: With the default computation, the rule adds this fixed amount to every payslip that uses it. Other computation types, such as a percentage or a Python formula, are available for more complex rules.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the rule.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the rule.

steps.description: Saving creates the rule. It is used the next time a payslip of this structure is computed.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving creates the rule. It is used the next time a payslip of this structure is computed.
